feedback: The onboarding process is confusing and I don't know what to do first.
The dashboard is easy to use and looks clean.
Reports are difficult to find and the navigation is confusing.
Inviting team members is confusing and takes too many steps.
Analytics is useful but sometimes very slow.
The onboarding tutorial needs to explain the setup process better.
I would like integrations with more third-party applications.
The dashboard gives me everything I need quickly.
I cannot understand how to generate a monthly report.
Setting up my workspace took much longer than expected.
